lineage.description: Drone orthomosaic imagery was collected by GLOBHE using crowddroning methodology in Chikwawa, Malawi following Tropical Storm Chalane. The georeferenced aerial imagery provides high-resolution spatial data of buildings and landscape features for exposure mapping, though the dataset itself does not contain quantified impact assessments or hazard measurements.
